summary: NaN's launch site for Jaune, a variable sans in three optical sizes (Maxi, Midi, Mini, on a 'dspl' axis plus wght), built as a stack of saturated colour bands that opens with a playable p5.js platform game ('I Shot the Serif') with a font-prize leaderboard. Below it, Fontsampler.js testers, an animated 'Variablicious' line, a hover overlay comparing the three optical sizes and a word-list carousel all teach the optical-size idea; a scrolling ticker on top and a fixed 'See More & Download Trial Fonts' bar at the bottom frame the page (neither was cut as a block).

instances.look: A green band with the line 'A typeface in three 👀 optical sizes' in neon green, barely contrasting with the background, a pair of googly eyes in place of the word; under a blue scrolling ticker
instances.ux: No nav; a marquee ticker above repeats the site description with links to NaN.xyz; the game sits directly below in the first screen
instances.learn: Replace one word of the tagline with a drawn object (googly eyes): the tagline becomes a joke and a mascot at once

reconstruction.behaviour: Ticker text scrolls continuously (Smarquee: --time 36.58s, --distance -1841px); googly eyes are two stacked spans (#whites, #pupils), their pupils probably move (unverified in the capture)

instances.look: Three coloured panels side by side: a red/salmon 'Leaderboard' with each heading letter in a dark round badge and 14 ranked names and scores; a coral game canvas with green heavy 'Click to Start', an emoji and '« Go Left (Space) Jump Go Right »'; a yellow column of chat bubbles ('I Shot the Serif', 'Win Fonts You Say?', 'How To Play')
instances.ux: Click to start a vertical jump-platformer drawn in p5.js (arrows/space, jump through side walls, avoid the devil); save your high score with name and e-mail; top 3 win the full family, places 4–10 a single weight; chat bubbles appear one after another
instances.learn: Turn the launch into a contest: a leaderboard with font prizes gives people a reason to come back and share the specimen
